document.title: Hover Title / Status
document.purpose: Record lightweight status-bar hover feedback for nodes.

summary: When the pointer hovers over a node, the status bar temporarily shows the node title, id, and kind. Untitled nodes show id and kind. Nodes with a URL append [link]. Moving off the node clears the hover overlay and restores the prior base status.

target-tokenization.source: tokenize_target() continues to produce DERIVED target facts with kind node and node_id when the pointer is over a node.
target-tokenization.pointer-motion: The canvas now binds Motion to a thin callback that updates RAW pointer facts and runs the app cycle.

behavior: Compares the target node id against workspace.hover.id.
Updates hover status only when the target changes.
Clears hover on empty target, handle target, canvas leave, project new/load, or hovered node deletion.

status-overlay.policy: status_set updates g.base_status. Hover updates g.hover_status. The actual label renders hover_status when present, otherwise base_status.

formatting.title-limit: Titles longer than 60 characters are truncated.

non-effects: Hover is not saved to project JSON.
Hover does not create history checkpoints.
Hover does not create world revisions.
Hover does not change inspector contents.
